data.narrative:
Alice & Bob is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Theau Peronnin and Raphael Lescanne, having raised €100M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public comparables (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised of €100M as a proxy baseline and applying a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x yields an implied valuation of €190M. Peer-median triangulation was not viable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the quantum computing sector; while 8 private peers exist in the broader space, none met the filtering criteria (same stage / adjacent stage / similar tier) necessary to establish a reliable narrowly-tailored cohort of three or more datapoints.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €162M (low) to €218M (high), with a median point of €190M. This range reflects uncertainty inherent in single-method triangulation and the nascent, heterogeneous nature of the quantum hardware market, where public and private valuation multiples remain volatile and stage-specific benchmarks vary considerably. Key uncertainties include the relative capital intensity and commercialization timelines of competing quantum modalities, and the absence of sufficient late-stage private comps to validate stage-progression assumptions in this sector.
